_comment: DELIVERED-1k op: the filter applied to the loosely-linked stream to produce the nightly ~1,000 artifact-clean 2-visit alert product. ONE FIXED OPERATING POINT for every night -- score_min 0.70 and chi2_2v_max 10.0, never adapted per night (user decision 2026-08-14, see _op_FIXED). A night thinner than full cadence simply delivers fewer than 1,000; that is accepted, not a fault to be corrected.
_dipole_veto: The morphology dipole veto is DMTN-007 style: flag a detection as a dipole if it is round-with-strong-peak-dipole (elong<1.6 & dipole>0.55) OR has a coherent adjacent NEGATIVE lobe in a small centred window (neg-lobe/pos-lobe flux>0.30 & neg-blob>=6px). The lobe measure catches ELONGATED dipoles (stretched +/- lobes) the roundness test misses -- validated 20260705 (dipoles with elong up to 3.0). Small window so a bright-star dipole in a stamp corner does NOT veto a real trail whose own centre is clean. Ref: dmtn-007.lsst.io.
_why_chi2: chi2 is the VOLUME KNOB and it is free: it filters AFTER the orbit solve, so the chi2<=X set is a strict SUBSET of the chi2<=30 linked stream and filtering costs no relink. It is ALSO a completeness knob, not only a purity one, and it does not act monotonically at a FIXED budget: tightening sheds real movers with noisy orbits, while loosening admits lower-quality candidates that DISPLACE real movers out of the 1,000 delivered slots. The optimum is therefore interior, and it sits at a different chi2 on every night (measured 6 to 18 across the full-cadence nights). 10.0 is the single value that best covers that spread -- see _op_FIXED.
_tradeoff: FLAGSHIP vs ALL peak at DIFFERENT chi2, measured on two injected nights, and per night the flagship optimum moves. Tune 20260706: flagship 2.09% at chi2<=8 vs ALL 12.08% at chi2<=12. Held-out 20260713: flagship 3.80% at chi2<=16 vs ALL 9.80% at chi2<=22. A single fixed 10.0 cannot sit on either optimum for every night; it is chosen to hit the DELIVERED-COUNT requirement instead, with the faint-fast cost quantified in _op_FIXED. score_min STAYS 0.70 and is never RAISED -- the sub-5sigma floor is the detector's purpose, and chi2 is geometry, not an SNR gate.
_drops: Confident-FP classes HARD-DROPPED (not flagged): stationary with BOTH endpoints counterpart, or n_counterparts>=3 (recurring static); static-line (staticVeto members); train (vetoTrain). KEPT+labelled: single-counterpart stationary (86% chance coincidence at 3in in a dense field -- dropping it sheds real slow movers; MEASURED 5.4% of delivered alerts carry vetoStationary, 18.0% on 20260711 -- that is the FLAG-not-drop policy working, not a leak). Then a morphology dipole veto (ADCNN.qa.alert_morphology: elong<1.6 & dipole>0.55) clears residual rings. These behaviours are UNCONDITIONAL in the implementations (filter_op._confident_fp and select_clean); this file used to carry drop_confident_fp / drop_stationary_single / morphology_dipole_veto booleans that NO code read (2026-08-15 audit: toggling each changed survivors 38->38, vs a real knob chi2 10->5 changing 38->7). Removed 2026-08-16: an op key must be a consumed parameter, not a description wearing a switch's syntax.
_note: 2-visit same-night purity is base-rate-limited (~0.17-0.56, ~8% at WFD); these thresholds remove IDENTIFIABLE artifact classes -- the residual is chance-link FP indistinguishable without a 3rd epoch. Real purity = a follow-up/3rd sighting.
_proximity: BRIGHT-STAR PROXIMITY veto: drop any alert with a member within 2.5in of a the_monster star brighter than mag 21. DEPTH IS THE POINT (measured 2026-08-06 on 0706 with an OFFSET NULL -- positions shifted 20-60in, which preserves footprint/density but decorrelates from stars, so the null rate IS the chance cost a real mover suffers): the residual dipole/RINGS in the delivered product sit on mag 19-21 stars, INVISIBLE to the old mag<19 refcat (surviving rings' nearest catalogued star was 26in away). mag<19/2.5in flags 21.7% of the product and 0% of the visible residual rings; mag<21/2.5in flags 55.8% including 42% of them, at an offset-null cost of 2.7% of real movers (vs 0.9%) -- ~20:1. The earlier '12% of real trails' figure was measured CIRCULARLY against ring-contaminated product alerts, not against a null. Needs the per-night refcat built with --mag-max 21 (build_refcats.sh).
_chi2_TRUTH: HISTORICAL, on the SOUNDNESS of the chi2 statistic (not its value -- the shipped value is FIXED 10.0, see _op_FIXED). A 2026-08-06 'measurement' claimed chi2<=9 discarded ~85% of real movers and briefly forced chi2 to 30. That was WRONG, produced by a bug in the injection harness: trail endpoints were built by treating the IMAGE-frame `beta` as a SKY position angle, so every trail was rotated by its detector's orientation; trail-vs-trail PA agreed to ~2deg while trail-vs-motion disagreed by ~48deg, and the dpa_tm>20 hard gate then appeared to kill 81% of true pairs. With endpoints correctly pushed through each panel's WCS (as detect_night does) the statistic is CONFIRMED SOUND: true-pair chi2 median 2.5 (it is designed to be ~Ndof), hard gates kill only 5.8%, and chi2<=5 retains 74.7% / <=7 ~80% / <=9 86.6% / <=30 93.9% of true pairs. Truth harness: outputs/runs/pa_validate (inject_v2.py, endpoints fixed 2026-08-07).
_veto_TRUTH: Veto TP cost measured on the same unbiased injected movers: confident-FP 0.0%, bright-star proximity 2.3% (offset-null predicted 2.7% -- CONFIRMED), stationarity>=1 counterpart 0.0%. The veto stack is essentially free, so it -- not the thresholds -- is where purity comes from. NOTE a first pass measured 25.4% for proximity; that was an INJECTION PLACEMENT BIAS (movers seeded at existing detection positions, 45.5% of which sit on stars because detections are ring-contaminated). Real asteroids land within 2.5in of a mag<21 star only 1.8% of the time. Seed injections at RANDOM sky.
_chi2_CEMENTED: CEMENTED 2026-08-13, RE-CONFIRMED the same day on a fresh held-out link. Basis: a 2D (score_min x chi2) scan at the DELIVERED 1k budget on two independently injected nights (20260706 TUNE, 5,315 movers, 1,386 flagship; 20260713 HELD OUT, 4,267 movers, 1,104 flagship; both uniform SNR 2-10 x seven trail lengths 7-56px; delivered scored by TRAIL-SEGMENT matching). FINDINGS. (1) score_min has NO effect on delivered completeness across 0.50/0.60/0.70 -- ALL 10.99% and flagship 2.09% at all three, at chi2<=8 -- while alert volume runs 36,974/19,537/9,668 and claim candidates 292,103/104,865/38,840. So 0.70 is free tractability, NOT a recall sacrifice. 0.80 is the first floor that costs completeness. Measured on the TUNE night only; the held-out night was linked at 0.70 alone. (2) A FIXED chi2 DOES NOT TRANSFER: the flagship optimum is chi2<=8 on 20260706 and chi2<=16 on 20260713 -- twice the value. Shipping the tuned 8 on the held-out night delivers 2.72% flagship against the 3.80% available (-28%), purely from UNDER-FILLING: chi2<=8 yields 692 survivors for 1,000 slots there, so the cut is pure loss with nothing displaced. (3) What DOES transfer is the BUDGET FILL RATIO, survivors/budget: 1.75 and 1.99 at the two flagship optima (and ~2.9-3.2 at the ALL optima on both). Hence chi2_2v_max = 'auto'. VERIFIED: target_fill 1.9 recovers each night's OWN flagship optimum EXACTLY -- chi2<=8 on tune, chi2<=16 on held-out -- and it is a PLATEAU, not a knife edge: 1.6-1.9 all pick 8 on tune, 1.75-2.0 all pick 16 on held-out. PROVENANCE: the tune arms and the held-out link both ran WITHOUT --train-veto. A separate held-out link WITH --train-veto (production-faithful; 336 of 4,131 alerts train-flagged, hard-dropped by _confident_fp) shifts the levels to flagship 3.35% and fill 1.83 at the SAME chi2<=16 optimum, and target_fill 1.9 still recovers it -- the pick is invariant to the veto, only the levels move.
_op_FIXED:
THE OPERATING POINT, fixed 2026-08-14 by user decision, calibrated on DELIVERED counts from eight real nights (not injections). REQUIREMENT: ~1,000 alerts on a full-cadence night; fewer on a thinner night is fine; ONE point that never changes.
score_min = 0.70. The 2D scan measured 0.50/0.60/0.70 to deliver IDENTICAL completeness (ALL 10.99%, flagship 2.09% at all three) while 0.70 links 7.5x fewer claim candidates -- free tractability. 0.80 is the first value that costs completeness, so the floor never goes UP.
chi2_2v_max = 10.0. MEASURED delivered counts at this value, by night (visits in parens): 20260708 (223) 1000, 20260629 (165) 1000, 20260706 (157) 1000, 20260705 (129) 721, 20260710 (88) 1000, 20260712 (82) 836, 20260711 (38) 1000, 20260630 (27) 1000. Six of eight at the budget; the shortfalls are the thin/field-sparse nights, which is the accepted behaviour. Alternatives measured: chi2 8 -> 20260705 delivers 474 and 20260708 917; chi2 12 -> every full-cadence night >=974 but the dense nights over-fill much harder.
KNOWN AND ACCEPTED COST: a fixed chi2 must stay loose enough for thin nights, so dense nights OVER-FILL and shed faint-fast movers by displacement at the fixed budget. Fill ratios at chi2 10: 20260706 6.2x, 20260710 3.0x, 20260629 2.5x, against a measured FLAGSHIP optimum near 1.9x. The scan measured flagship 2.09% -> 1.44% (-31%) going from 1.75x to 3.15x fill, still falling to 0.65% at ~9.7x. So roughly a third of faint-fast completeness is given up on the densest nights. This is the deliberate price of a single unchanging operating point; do not 'fix' it by making chi2 adaptive again without asking.
NOTE 20260705 has 129 visits but only 3,451 alerts: yield tracks FIELD DENSITY, not cadence alone, so visit count does not predict whether a night reaches the budget.
_chi2_AUTO_SUPERSEDED: SUPERSEDED 2026-08-14 by _op_FIXED. chi2_2v_max was briefly 'auto', picked per night by filter_op to reach target_fill 1.9 x budget, because a FIXED chi2 does not transfer across cadence (measured flagship optimum 8 on 20260706, 16 on 20260713) while the FILL RATIO does (1.75 and 1.99 at those optima), and target_fill 1.9 recovered each night's own optimum exactly, held-out included. That measurement STANDS and is why the fixed point costs what _op_FIXED says it costs. It was replaced because the user requires ONE unchanging operating point, which is a product decision, not a refutation of the scan.
